params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: mode
params.description: Level of detail in the response.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

items.docs:
#### Modes
Levels of detail in the response - `list`, `normal`, `detailed`

Example - [/celestial_bodies/?mode=list](./?mode=list)

#### Search
Fields searched - `name`, `type__name`

Example - [/celestial_bodies/?search=Mars](./?search=Mars)

#### Ordering
Fields - `id`, `name`

Example - [/celestial_bodies/?ordering=-name](./?ordering=-name)

#### Number of results
Use `limit` to control the number of objects in the response (max 100)

Example - [/celestial_bodies/?limit=2](./?limit=2)

#### F
